newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Slavneft Jan-Sept pre-tax profit 684 bln rbls.
newsitem.headline: Slavneft Jan-Sept pre-tax profit 684 bln rbls.

text.p: Pre-tax profit at Russian-Belarussian oil group Slavneft was 684 billion roubles in the first nine months of 1996 after 1.48 trillion roubles in the whole of 1995, the company said on Tuesday.
NOTE - Full name NGK Slavneft. Main operating unit is Megionneftegaz. Balance sheet items at end of period. Figures to Russian accounting standards, accruals basis.

Russian accounting standards differ significantly from those normally supplied in the West. Russian accounts are designed to meet the requirements of the tax authorities. Definitions of profit and assets differ significantly from those in the West, and converting Russian accounts to international standards can turn a profit into a loss.
Figures are not adjusted for inflation or the depreciation of the rouble, but the following data may be helpful.
